paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: Comparison of correlation between training loss (cross-entropy objective loss for Consistency-CE and Bi-objective loss for Consistency-Bi) and translation quality (BLEU score) on train subset of WMT15 De-En task for wait-k policy.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the correlation between training loss and translation quality (measured by BLEU score) on the train subset of the WMT15 De-En task under the wait-k policy, comparing two methods: Consistency-CE and Consistency-Bi. The x-axis, labeled “testing k,” spans integer values from 1 to 9 with a linear scale and tick marks at every integer. The y-axis, labeled “Correlation,” ranges from 0.5 to 0.95 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The blue dashed line with circular markers represents “Consistency-CE,” starting at approximately 0.62 when k=1, rising steadily to 0.70 at k=3, then gradually increasing to about 0.75 at k=9. The orange solid line with square markers represents “Consistency-Bi,” beginning at approximately 0.93 when k=1, rising slightly to 0.95 at k=3, and then plateauing near 0.95 for k from 5 to 9. Both lines show increasing or stable correlation as k increases, with Consistency-Bi consistently maintaining a higher correlation than Consistency-CE across all tested k values.
